name: @estate/estate-brain
description: Estate-brain: the fleet's single source of truth for crew rosters, personas, signing identities, keys, and tokens. Consolidates the old squawk-persona registry with the corral crews roster/personas/identity-specs. Regenerates $SQUAWK_ROOT/runners.yml and exports runtime env for agents. Zero hard deps, Bun.

scripts.validate: bun run typecheck && bun run test:coverage && bun run lint
scripts.coverage:ratchet: bun test --coverage --coverage.reporter=json-summary && bun x vyper-spec coverage:ratchet
scripts.lint: bun x biome check src tests bin
scripts.format: bun x biome format --write src tests bin
